sloka: श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं सीता मुनेः परममद्भुतम् ।शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य चरणौ तथेत्याह कृताञ्जलिः ।। ७.४९.१७ ॥
transliteration: śrutvā tu bhāṣitaṁ sītā muneḥ paramamadbhutam ।śirasā ' 'vandya caraṇau tathetyāha kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 7.49.17 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the supremely wonderful words of the sage, Sita, with folded hands, bowed down to his feet with her head and said, "So be it."
